steps.caption: Home
steps.narration: Needs attention, on Home in the ConstructHUB CRM, is your list of people to get back to.

steps.caption: New leads
steps.narration: New leads are the jobs that came in over the last two weeks.

steps.caption: Needs an estimate
steps.narration: Needs an estimate lists the leads that don't have an estimate yet.

steps.caption: Follow-ups
steps.narration: For clients you want to keep in touch with, choose Follow-ups.

steps.caption: Add them
steps.narration: Click their name, and they start on a weekly rhythm.

steps.caption: Next due
steps.narration: The row shows when the next follow-up is due.

steps.caption: Biweekly
steps.narration: Change the rhythm to Biweekly, or choose Off to stop it.

steps.caption: When it comes due
steps.narration: When a follow-up comes due, the client lands in Needs attention.

steps.caption: Close
steps.narration: Call them, then choose Done beside their name, and the count starts again.

steps.caption: Menu: Home
steps.narration: You'll find Needs attention on Home, at the top of the menu.

youtube.title: How to work your follow-ups | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of Needs attention on Home in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will see your new leads and the leads that still need an estimate, and put clients on a weekly or biweekly follow-up rhythm.
